description: Papua New Guinea- Wind Measurement Data is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Wind", published or maintained by Luc Dewilde (World Bank Group). Data repository for measurements from 3 wind masts in Papua New Guinea. Data transmits daily reports for wind speed, wind direction, air pressure, relative humidity and temperature. Coverage: Papua New Guinea. It has 16 files in PDF, CSV, ZIP. The portal files it under Wind. The portal gives 2018 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
